summary: Stale venv cleanup menu and Rust scanning extraction

delivery.outcome: Startup menu exposes stale venv cleanup, default 30 days with configurable age, inventory counts and bytes before explicit deletion; extract filesystem traversal and measurement into Rust packages in semcod/fixos-native and integrate a bounded optional native backend with Python fallback.
nonGoals: No cleanup is executed on user projects during implementation
No automatic deletion from ambiguous, unreadable or active projects
No remote repository creation or publication in this session

architecture.decision: Separate read-only scanning from confirmation and revalidated deletion. Native CLI protocol provides reusable project discovery and tree measurement without taking deletion authority. Python fallback preserves installation compatibility. Rust packages have a separate repository ticket and owner. Component ownership, discovery policy and deletion authority remain in FixOS; native code is an optional read-only primitive and Python implementations are retained.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket source changes; optional native executable can be uninstalled independently.

validation.evidence: Local test output and checkpoint receipts
